column1: # Curated Greek/Latin naming morphemes (Phase 141, roadmap phase 3).
# Columns: form <TAB> origin(G|L) <TAB> gloss <TAB> comma-separated tags
# Glosses/tags are plain English so brief keywords (and their semantic-field
# neighbors) can select morphemes by meaning. Forms are the combining forms
# naming agencies actually use. Curated from the public Wikipedia "List of
# Greek and Latin roots in English" (CC BY-SA) plus standard naming practice.
